edits.target: - If the input itself redefines a symbol inconsistently (the same letter used for two different propositions), keep the first definition and assign a fresh symbol to the second.
edits.content: - If the input itself redefines a symbol inconsistently (the same letter used for two different propositions), keep the first definition and assign a fresh symbol to the second — and use that fresh symbol in place of the original letter in every formula appearing after the redefinition point, since those occurrences refer to the new meaning, not the original one.
